notes.title: Prepare Full Release of Throw Anything!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/258feafea3ba99f78664d42800a52974a7923e6a.png[/img]

Hello! This is Throw Anything!

Our game, Throw Anything's, Full Release will be July 27!

Prepare onslaught of new zombies and new Final Bosses!

Who destroyed the city? Where did zombies come from?
 
Various weapons and new stages are waiting for you!

The long-awaited ending of Throw Anything will be released next week!

Never miss this opportunity!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/fac35b224aa98bd4f1efbfb1f7159ce046122c8c.png[/img]

Who dares to play God and revive dead ones!

Mystery Scientist X finally shows himself!



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/7cee0b208dc106789f32a4fbd808cd799228f061.png[/img]
[h1]"What are these?"[/h1]

Prepare New Challenges in the New Stage!

Unlock all Achievements if you can!

Challenge yourself to survive and save the world!

notes.title: Throw Anything patch note Version 1.0!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/eb75fdb0c01c9caef1496fbd3eedcab194b31540.png[/img]
[h1][b]Throw Anything patch note Version 1.0![/b][/h1]
Throw anything's update is done! In this update, you'll be able to experience vending machine, new interactions, and new effects with improvement!

[h1][b]Vending machine:[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/03b3891975d33f2cdc05fe746d2cef1a87270b45.gif[/img]
ㆍNow the vending machine is added on lobby! The vending machine can use the points from the game to get weapons that can be used in the next stage! But be aware, all points are lost after the game starts! If you have accumulated enough points, be sure to check the lobby!

[h1][b]Easy & Hard:[/b][/h1]

ㆍSeveral streamers and users say that the game is difficult so we decide adjust the difficulty of game. Plus, easy mod and hard mod is now available! Now try your own limit!

[h1][b]Balance:[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/05666b1979faa42a6ceb043ac50e0470c862a435.gif[/img]
ㆍNow the game player & it's cartridge is added in Stage 1! Combine game player and cartridge to get powerful items!
ㆍNew NPC zombie is added on Stage 5.
ㆍNow the bombs, grenades, and rocket launcher brings more massive explosions.
ㆍWhen safe is open before password comes, it never comes from delivery.

[h1][b]UI & Effect:[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/923dab1c326bd49915a5915777ac96e9ff59a93f.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/02ff30f877b6d820e7a311dc98ba78c8d2c525c7.gif[/img]
ㆍNow sound option is added on lobby.
ㆍDifficulty level button is also added on lobby.
ㆍWhen one of Jack or Shane lost all health, creepy aura come out to the other.

[h1][b]Bug fixed:[/b][/h1]

ㆍFixed bug when delivery copied by copy machine brings no item.
ㆍFixed bug achievement 'grand rescue' applied to all login player.

Please check our twitter and Facebook for more information of our game!

notes.title: Throw Anything patch note Version 0.1!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/89fd81456a9678e5edf45d2da3f608467990df6d.png[/img]
[h1][b]Throw Anything patch note Version 0.1![/b][/h1]
Howdy! This is Throw anything!
We always appreciate your interest in our game!
For your better playing, we decided to release our first patch note.

[h1][b]ㆍA less stupid NPC[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/f1d663700aa56c69066dc00f360e7f1815a37302.gif[/img]
NPC would no longer return to its default position when it touch window frame, but modify window frame to push or pull NPC to its direction. And also, NPC won’t stuck to you anymore!

[h1][b]ㆍRefrigerator wants more food! (Stage 3)[/b][/h1]
The refrigerator has been modified to catch food! Now refrigerator will no longer reflect any object before freeze it.

[h1][b]ㆍZombie always need ‘Molotov’! (Stage 3)[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/6741f5141c749fc3b1431a9be5f73c5521cada36.gif[/img]
The new item ‘Molotov’ is now added on room & delivery services! Throw ‘Molotov’ to wall will create flame wall which deals damage to passing zombies.

[h1][b]ㆍFreeze everything, ‘Blizzard gauntlet’ (Stage 3)[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/00195732d562298c1ec82e6cc5ec42b8e5059bc3.gif[/img]
The new item ‘Blizzard gauntlet’ is now added on mailbox! Wear ‘Blizzard gauntlet’ and touch any object to freeze (Include zombies)! Throwing frozen object will make zombies tremble in cold. Also, speed of pulling object will increase.

[h1][b]ㆍA troublesome fly (Bird zombie)[/b][/h1]
Bird zombies are no longer harmful than before, it will spend more time to kill you!

[h1][b]ㆍNew achievements[/b][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912743/c6c08c5b1f95b0830faa5a4a80a334153b754b99.png[/img]
New achievements have been added. User who have already accomplished this new achievement will apply at the beginning of the game.

[h1][b]ㆍTutorial mod has been updated![/b][/h1]
Now tutorials are more granular for beginners to follow!
And also tutorial teaches you how to interact between torch and fuel!
So for passing Stage 3, you must play it again!

[h1][b]And here’s our next update plan![/b][/h1]
ㆍMore items!
ㆍDifficulty selection!
ㆍMore stories!
ㆍBuff some items!

Please check our twitter, and facebook for more information of our game!
